name: playwright-saucedemo
description: Automatización Front-End de SauceDemo con Playwright + Cucumber (BDD) y Page Object Model

scripts.test-visual: cross-env ENV=dev BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=false SLOWMO=700 cucumber-js --config=config/cucumber.js
scripts.test-debug: cross-env ENV=dev BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=false PWDEBUG=1 cucumber-js --config=config/cucumber.js
scripts.posttest-dev: cross-env ENV=dev BROWSER=chrome npm run reportes
scripts.posttest-uat: cross-env ENV=uat BROWSER=chrome npm run reportes
scripts.posttest-firefox: cross-env ENV=dev BROWSER=firefox npm run reportes
scripts.posttest-webkit: cross-env ENV=dev BROWSER=webkit npm run reportes
scripts.posttest-login: cross-env ENV=dev BROWSER=chrome npm run reportes
scripts.posttest-carrito: cross-env ENV=dev BROWSER=chrome npm run reportes
scripts.posttest-checkout: cross-env ENV=dev BROWSER=chrome npm run reportes
scripts.allure-report: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
